runs.text: Japan isn't called Japan. It's <<n|i|ˈ|h|ɔ|n>>, or <<n|i|ˈ|p|ɔ|n>>. Written sun and origin: where the sun rises. China is <<ˌ|dʒ|ʊ|ŋ|ˈ|g|w|ɔ>>. The middle kingdom. Korea comes from <<ˈ|g|oʊ|r|j|ɔ>>, an old dynasty. South Korea calls itself <<ˈ|h|ɑ|n|g|u|k>>. Mongolia is Mongol <<ˈ|uː|l|s>>. India's constitution says it in Article one: India, that is <<ˈ|b|ɑ|r|ə|t>>. Sri Lanka was Ceylon until nineteen seventy two. Sri Lanka means: resplendent island. Bhutan is <<ˈ|d|r|ʊ|k>> <<ˈ|j|uː|l>>. The land of the thunder dragon. In English, Thailand was Siam until nineteen thirty nine. At home, it's <<p|r|ə|ˈ|t|ɛ|t>> Thai. Cambodia is <<ˌ|k|æ|m|p|uː|ˈ|tʃ|iː|ə>>. Georgia is <<s|ɑ|ˌ|k|ɑ|r|t|ˈ|v|ɛ|l|oʊ>>, land of the <<k|ɑ|r|t|ˈ|v|iː|l|i|ə|n|z>>. And Armenia is <<ˌ|h|ɑ|j|ɑ|s|ˈ|t|ɑ|n>>, land of the <<ˈ|h|aɪ>>.
